ValidationRule.description: Prevents edits to PHOCS Contacts associated with Business Entity or Facility Accounts unless the user has the PHOCS Officer permission. - Updated to only Officers
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSContact", OR(Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Business_Entity", Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "DrinkingWaterSourceIntake", Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "DrinkingWaterSystem", Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Facility"), $Permission.PHOCSOfficer )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Officers cannot edit this Contact record.
